description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git operations related to branch overwriting, worktrees, fetches, rebases, and error handling. It contains multiple test cases to verify Git behavior when force-updating branches or performing fetch and rebase operations under various worktree and state conditions.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates an initial commit or a commit with a specified message, used to set up test scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution of the enclosed commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs commands expected to fail and verifies they do indeed fail.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to be run after test completion.

methods.name: test_editor_unchanged
methods.description: Checks that the editor environment remains unchanged after tests.

methods.name: set_cat_todo_editor
methods.description: Sets up an environment for editing rebase TODOs.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
